property_summary: After any successful transferFrom(id), the token's owner must become the recipient (ownerOf(id)==to); the mutant never updates _ownerOf, so ownerOf stays the old owner for some transfer.

For any admissible input, once an NFT is transferred via transferFrom, the previous owner can no longer transfer it again (ownership actually moved); the mutant leaves _ownerOf unchanged, so the old owner can transfer the same token a second time.

For any admissible input, once an owner transfers an NFT via transferFrom, the previous owner can no longer approve spenders for that token (approve reverts with NOT_AUTHORIZED since _ownerOf moved); the mutant never updates _ownerOf, so the old owner still approves, violating the rule.

Any transferFrom call on a token that is not minted (its owner is address(0)) must revert, so ownerOf(id) can never become non-zero through an unminted transfer; the mutant lets msg.sender==from bypass the ownership check and silently assigns unminted tokens, making such calls succeed.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(address,address,uint256): unminted token must be untransferable and stay unminted

property_summary: For any signed order, filling it a second time must revert because the position id was already minted, so ownerOf(hashOppositeOrder(order)) permanently remains the first filler; the mutant re-mints and steals the id, reassigning ownership to the second filler.

A minted position id is immutable with respect to minting: once fillOrder mints the opposite-order position id to the first filler, any later fill of the same signed order must revert and leave ownerOf(that id) unchanged; the mutant silently re-mints, transferring ownership to a second filler.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(uint256,address,address): remint of existing id must revert and leave owners unchanged

property_summary: Transferring an owned token leaves every untouched balance untouched, and in particular a self-transfer of a token must leave the owner's token balance exactly unchanged: the reference conserves the sender's balance on transferFrom, while the mutant skips `_balanceOf[from]--` so a self-transfer inflates the sender's balance by one.

For any order, a token owner self-transferring a minted position NFT must leave their token balance exactly unchanged (transferFrom conserves the sender's balance); the mutant skips _balanceOf[from]--, so a self-transfer inflates the sender's balance and breaks this conservation for a filled order.
